definitions.explanation: Contains no sugar. Commonly seen on food and beverage labels.

examples.japanese: {無糖|むとう}のコーヒーをください。
examples.english: I'll have an unsweetened coffee, please.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}は{無糖|むとう}の{飲|の}み{物|もの}が{人気|にんき}だ。
examples.english: Sugar-free beverages are popular these days.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}のために、{無糖|むとう}のヨーグルトを{毎朝|まいあさ}{食|た}べている。
examples.english: For my health, I eat unsweetened yogurt every morning.

notes: Commonly seen on product labels as {無糖|むとう} or in the の-adjective form {無糖|むとう}の. Part of a series of food labeling terms: {無糖|むとう} (sugar-free), {低糖|ていとう} (low sugar), {微糖|びとう} (slightly sweet, common for canned coffee), and {加糖|かとう} (sugar added). The {無|む} prefix means "without" and appears in many similar compounds like {無塩|むえん} (salt-free) and {無脂肪|むしぼう} (fat-free).
